source: Florida House Appropriations Project bills for the 2020 session (FY 2020-21) filed by Avila, Donalds, Fernandez, Ingoglia, Rodriguez: listed from flsenate.gov House bill lists filtered by Filed By (co-introducers included, role 'cosponsor'), amount/agency/APR number from each bill's filed text. Request forms (date, recipient, lobbyist) are on flhouse.gov (https://www.flhouse.gov/Sections/Appropriations/projectbills.aspx?SessionId=89); formRead says whether one was read. Budget status: the bill number looked up as '(HB n)' in the HB 5001 General Appropriations Act as printed in the Laws of Florida (ch. 2020-111), where vetoed language is struck through.
